positions.label: Obstacle
positions.prompt_hint: what is in the way, or what the pull is against

positions.label: Advice
positions.prompt_hint: where this could land, and what to do with it

cards.name: The Fool
cards.imagery_line: With light step, as if earth and its trammels had little power to restrain him, a young man in gorgeous vestments pauses at the brink of a precipice among the great heights of the world;

meanings.general: Folly, mania, extravagance, intoxication, delirium, frenzy, bewrayment

cards.name: The Magician
cards.imagery_line: A youthful figure in the robe of a magician, having the countenance of divine Apollo, with smile of confidence and shining eyes.

meanings.general: Skill, diplomacy, address, subtlety

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.imagery_line: She has the lunar crescent at her feet, a horned diadem on her head, with a globe in the middle place, and a large solar cross on her breast.

meanings.general: Secrets, mystery, the future as yet unrevealed

cards.name: The Empress
cards.imagery_line: A stately figure, seated, having rich vestments and royal aspect, as of a daughter of heaven and earth.

meanings.general: Fruitfulness, action, initiative, length of days

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.imagery_line: He has a form of the Crux ansata for his sceptre and a globe in his left hand.

meanings.general: Stability, power, protection, realization

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.imagery_line: He wears the triple crown and is seated between two pillars, but they are not those of the Temple which is guarded by the High Priestess.

meanings.general: Marriage, alliance, captivity, servitude

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.imagery_line: The sun shines in the zenith, and beneath is a great winged figure with arms extended, pouring down influences.

meanings.general: Attraction, love, beauty, trials overcome

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.imagery_line: An erect and princely figure carrying a drawn sword and corresponding, broadly speaking, to the traditional description which I have given in the first part.

meanings.general: Succour, providence also war, triumph, presumption, vengeance, trouble

cards.name: Strength
cards.imagery_line: A woman, over whose head there broods the same symbol of life which we have seen in the card of the Magician, is closing the jaws of a lion.

meanings.general: Power, energy, action, courage, magnanimity

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.imagery_line: The variation from the conventional models in this card is only that the lamp is not enveloped partially in the mantle of its bearer, who blends the idea of the Ancient of Days with the Light of the World It is a star which shines in the lantern.

meanings.general: Prudence, circumspection

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.imagery_line: In this symbol I have again followed the reconstruction of Éliphas Lévi, who has furnished several variants.

meanings.general: Destiny, fortune, success, elevation, luck, felicity

cards.name: Justice
cards.imagery_line: As this card follows the traditional symbolism and carries above all its obvious meanings, there is little to say regarding it outside the few considerations collected in the first part, to which the reader is referred.

meanings.general: Equity, rightness, probity, executive

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.imagery_line: The gallows from which he is suspended forms a Tau cross, while the figure--from the position of the legs--forms a fylfot cross.

meanings.general: Wisdom, circumspection, discernment, trials, sacrifice, intuition, divination, prophecy

cards.name: Death
cards.imagery_line: The veil or mask of life is perpetuated in change, transformation and passage from lower to higher, and this is more fitly represented in the rectified Tarot by one of the apocalyptic visions than by the crude notion of the reaping skeleton.

meanings.general: End, mortality, destruction, corruption also, for a man, the loss of a benefactor for a woman, many contrarieties

cards.name: Temperance
cards.imagery_line: A winged angel, with the sign of the sun upon his forehead and on his breast the square and triangle of the septenary.

meanings.general: Economy, moderation, frugality, management, accommodation

cards.name: The Devil
cards.imagery_line: The design is an accommodation, mean or harmony, between several motives mentioned in the first part.

meanings.general: Ravage, violence, vehemence, extraordinary efforts, force, fatality

cards.name: The Tower
cards.imagery_line: Occult explanations attached to this card are meagre and mostly disconcerting.

meanings.general: Misery, distress, indigence, adversity, calamity, disgrace, deception, ruin. It is a card in particular of unforeseen catastrophe

cards.name: The Star
cards.imagery_line: A great, radiant star of eight rays, surrounded by seven lesser stars--also of eight rays.

meanings.general: Loss, theft, privation, abandonment

cards.name: The Moon
cards.imagery_line: The distinction between this card and some of the conventional types is that the moon is increasing on what is called the side of mercy, to the right of the observer.

meanings.general: Hidden enemies, danger, calumny, darkness, terror, deception, occult forces, error

cards.name: The Sun
cards.imagery_line: The naked child mounted on a white horse and displaying a red standard has been mentioned already as the better symbolism connected with this card.

meanings.general: Material happiness, fortunate marriage, contentment

cards.name: Judgement
cards.imagery_line: I have said that this symbol is essentially invariable in all Tarot sets, or at least the variations do not alter its character.

meanings.general: Change of position, renewal, outcome. Another account specifies total loss though lawsuit

cards.name: The World
cards.imagery_line: As this final message of the Major Trumps is unchanged--and indeed unchangeable--in respect of its design, it has been partly described already regarding its deeper sense.

meanings.general: Assured success, recompense, voyage, route, emigration, flight, change of place

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.imagery_line: The waters are beneath, and thereon are water-lilies;

meanings.general: House of the true heart, joy, content, abode, nourishment, abundance, fertility

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A youth and maiden are pledging one another, and above their cups rises the Caduceus of Hermes, between the great wings of which there appears a lion's head.

meanings.general: Love, passion, friendship, affinity, union, concord, sympathy, the interrelation of the sexes, and--as a suggestion apart from all offices of divination--that desire which is not in Nature, but by which Nature is sanctified

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.imagery_line: Maidens in a garden-ground with cups uplifted, as if pledging one another.

meanings.general: The conclusion of any matter in plenty, perfection and merriment

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A young man is seated under a tree and contemplates three cups set on the grass before him;

meanings.general: Weariness, disgust, aversion, imaginary vexations, as if the wine of this world had caused satiety only

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A dark, cloaked figure, looking sideways at three prone cups two others stand upright behind him;

meanings.general: A dark, cloaked figure, looking sideways at three prone cups two others stand upright behind him

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.imagery_line: Children in an old garden, their cups filled with flowers.

meanings.general: A card of the past and of memories, looking back, as--for example--on childhood

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.imagery_line: Strange chalices of vision, but the images are more especially those of the fantastic spirit.

meanings.general: Fairy favours, images of reflection, sentiment, imagination, things seen in the glass of contemplation

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A man of dejected aspect is deserting the cups of his felicity, enterprise, undertaking or previous concern.

meanings.general: The card speaks for itself on the surface, but other readings are entirely antithetical--giving joy, mildness, timidity, honour, modesty. In practice, it is usually found that the card shews the decline of a matter, or that a matter which has been thought to be important is really of slight consequence--either for good or evil

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A goodly personage has feasted to his heart's content, and abundant refreshment of wine is on the arched counter behind him, seeming to indicate that the future is also assured.

meanings.general: Concord, contentment, physical bien-être

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.imagery_line: Appearance of Cups in a rainbow;

meanings.general: Contentment, repose of the entire heart

cards.name: Page of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A fair, pleasing, somewhat effeminate page, of studious and intent aspect, contemplates a fish rising from a cup to look at him.

meanings.general: Fair young man, one impelled to render service and with whom the Querent will be connected

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.imagery_line: Graceful, but not warlike;

meanings.general: Arrival, approach--sometimes that of a messenger

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.imagery_line: Beautiful, fair, dreamy--as one who sees visions in a cup.

meanings.general: Good, fair woman

cards.name: King of Cups
cards.imagery_line: He holds a short sceptre in his left hand and a great cup in his right;

meanings.general: Fair man, man of business, law, or divinity

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A hand--issuing, as usual, from a cloud--holds up a pentacle.

meanings.general: Perfect contentment, felicity, ecstasy

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A young man, in the act of dancing, has a pentacle in either hand, and they are joined by that endless cord which is like the number 8 reversed.

meanings.general: On the one hand it is represented as a card of gaiety, recreation and its connexions, which is the subject of the design

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A sculptor at his work in a monastery.

meanings.general: Métier, trade, skilled labour

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A crowned figure, having a pentacle over his crown, clasps another with hands and arms;

meanings.general: The surety of possessions, cleaving to that which one has, gift, legacy, inheritance

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: Two mendicants in a snow-storm pass a lighted casement.

meanings.general: The card foretells material trouble above all, whether in the form illustrated--that is, destitution--or otherwise. For some cartomancists, it is a card of love and lovers-wife, husband, friend, mistress

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A person in the guise of a merchant weighs money in a pair of scales and distributes it to the needy and distressed.

meanings.general: Presents, gifts, gratification another account says attention, vigilance now is the accepted time, present prosperity, etc

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A young man, leaning on his staff, looks intently at seven pentacles attached to a clump of greenery on his right;

meanings.general: These are exceedingly contradictory

cards.name: Eight of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: An artist in stone at his work, which he exhibits in the form of trophies.

meanings.general: Work, employment, commission, craftsmanship, skill in craft and business, perhaps in the preparatory stage

cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A woman, with a bird upon her wrist, stands amidst a great abundance of grapevines in the garden of a manorial house.

meanings.general: Prudence, safety, success, accomplishment, certitude, discernment

cards.name: Ten of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A man and woman beneath an archway which gives entrance to a house and domain.

meanings.general: Gain, riches

cards.name: Page of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A youthful figure, looking intently at the pentacle which hovers over his raised hands.

meanings.general: Application, study, scholarship, reflection another reading says news, messages and the bringer thereof

cards.name: Knight of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: He rides a slow, enduring, heavy horse, to which his own aspect corresponds.

meanings.general: Utility, serviceableness, interest, responsibility, rectitude-all on the normal and external plane

cards.name: Queen of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: The face suggests that of a dark woman, whose qualities might be summed up in the idea of greatness of soul;

meanings.general: Opulence, generosity, magnificence, security, liberty

cards.name: King of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: The figure calls for no special description the face is rather dark, suggesting also courage, but somewhat lethargic in tendency.

meanings.general: Valour, realizing intelligence, business and normal intellectual aptitude, sometimes mathematical gifts and attainments of this kind

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A hand issues from a cloud, grasping as word, the point of which is encircled by a crown.

meanings.general: Triumph, the excessive degree in everything, conquest, triumph of force. It is a card of great force, in love as well as in hatred. The crown may carry a much higher significance than comes usually within the sphere of fortune-telling

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A hoodwinked female figure balances two swords upon her shoulders.

meanings.general: Conformity and the equipoise which it suggests, courage, friendship, concord in a state of arms

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.imagery_line: Three swords piercing a heart;

meanings.general: Removal, absence, delay, division, rupture, dispersion, and all that the design signifies naturally, being too simple and obvious to call for specific enumeration

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.imagery_line: The effigy of a knight in the attitude of prayer, at full length upon his tomb.

meanings.general: Vigilance, retreat, solitude, hermit's repose, exile, tomb and coffin. It is these last that have suggested the design

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A disdainful man looks after two retreating and dejected figures.

meanings.general: Degradation, destruction, revocation, infamy, dishonour, loss, with the variants and analogues of these

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A ferryman carrying passengers in his punt to the further shore.

meanings.general: Journey by water, route, way, envoy, commissionary, expedient

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A man in the act of carrying away five swords rapidly;

meanings.general: Design, attempt, wish, hope, confidence

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A woman, bound and hoodwinked, with the swords of the card about her.

meanings.general: Bad news, violent chagrin, crisis, censure, power in trammels, conflict, calumny

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.imagery_line: One seated on her couch in lamentation, with the swords over her.

meanings.general: Death, failure, miscarriage, delay, deception, disappointment, despair

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A prostrate figure, pierced by all the swords belonging to the card.

meanings.general: Whatsoever is intimated by the design

cards.name: Page of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A lithe, active figure holds a sword upright in both hands, while in the act of swift walking.

meanings.general: Authority, overseeing, secret service, vigilance, spying, examination, and the qualities thereto belonging

cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.imagery_line: He is riding in full course, as if scattering his enemies.

meanings.general: Skill, bravery, capacity, defence, address, enmity, wrath, war, destruction, opposition, resistance, ruin. There is therefore a sense in which the card signifies death, but it carries this meaning only in its proximity to other cards of fatality

cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.imagery_line: Her right hand raises the weapon vertically and the hilt rests on an arm of her royal chair the left hand is extended, the arm raised her countenance is severe but chastened;

meanings.general: Widowhood, female sadness and embarrassment, absence, sterility, mourning, privation, separation

cards.name: King of Swords
cards.imagery_line: He sits in judgment, holding the unsheathed sign of his suit.

meanings.general: Whatsoever arises out of the idea of judgment and all its connexions-power, command, authority, militant intelligence, law, offices of the crown, and so forth

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.imagery_line: A hand issuing from a cloud grasps a stout wand or club.

meanings.general: Creation, invention, enterprise, the powers which result in these

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.imagery_line: A tall man looks from a battlemented roof over sea and shore;

meanings.general: Between the alternative readings there is no marriage possible

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.imagery_line: A calm, stately personage, with his back turned, looking from a cliff's edge at ships passing over the sea.

meanings.general: He symbolizes established strength, enterprise, effort, trade, commerce, discovery

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.imagery_line: From the four great staves planted in the foreground there is a great garland suspended;

meanings.general: They are for once almost on the surface--country life, haven of refuge, a species of domestic harvest-home, repose, concord, harmony, prosperity, peace, and the perfected work of these

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.imagery_line: A posse of youths, who are brandishing staves, as if in sport or strife.

meanings.general: Imitation, as, for example, sham fight, but also the strenuous competition and struggle of the search after riches and fortune. In this sense it connects with the battle of life. Hence some attributions say that it is a card of gold, gain, opulence

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.imagery_line: A laurelled horseman bears one staff adorned with a laurel crown;

meanings.general: The card has been so designed that it can cover several significations

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.imagery_line: A young man on a craggy eminence brandishing a staff;

meanings.general: It is a card of valour, for, on the surface, six are attacking one, who has, however, the vantage position. On the intellectual plane, it signifies discussion, wordy strife

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.imagery_line: The card represents motion through the immovable-a flight of wands through an open country;

meanings.general: Activity in undertakings, the path of such activity, swiftness, as that of an express messenger

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.imagery_line: The figure leans upon his staff and has an expectant look, as if awaiting an enemy.

meanings.general: The card signifies strength in opposition. If attacked, the person will meet an onslaught boldly

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.imagery_line: A man oppressed by the weight of the ten staves which he is carrying.

meanings.general: A card of many significances, and some of the readings cannot be harmonized. I set aside that which connects it with honour and good faith. The chief meaning is oppression simply, but it is also fortune, gain, any kind of success, and then it is the oppression of these things. It is also a card of false-seeming, disguise, perfidy. The place which the figure is approaching may suffer from the rods that he carries. Success is stultified if the Nine of Swords follows, and if it is a question of a lawsuit, there will be certain loss

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.imagery_line: In a scene similar to the former, a young man stands in the act of proclamation.

meanings.general: Dark young man, faithful, a lover, an envoy, a postman. Beside a man, he will bear favourable testimony concerning him. A dangerous rival, if followed by the Page of Cups. Has the chief qualities of his suit. He may signify family intelligence

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.imagery_line: He is shewn as if upon a journey, armed with a short wand, and although mailed is not on a warlike errand.

meanings.general: Departure, absence, flight, emigration. A dark young man, friendly. Change of residence

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.imagery_line: The Wands throughout this suit are always in leaf, as it is a suit of life and animation.

meanings.general: A dark woman, countrywoman, friendly, chaste, loving, honourable. If the card beside her signifies a man, she is well disposed towards him

cards.name: King of Wands
cards.imagery_line: The physical and emotional nature to which this card is attributed is dark, ardent, lithe, animated, impassioned, noble.

meanings.general: Dark man, friendly, countryman, generally married, honest and conscientious. The card always signifies honesty, and may mean news concerning an unexpected heritage to fall in before very long
